| Deploy on table if you've won a Podrace. Once per game, may place Boonta Eve Podrace out of play to retrieve 4 Force. If you occupy a battleground site and a battleground system, once during each of your control phases may {{Errata hl|1=take}} the bottom card of your Lost Pile and place it on top of your Force Pile. At the end of opponent's turn opponent must lose 2 Force or place their Force Pile onto their Used Pile. || Deploy on table if you've won a Podrace. Once per game, may place Boonta Eve Podrace out of play to retrieve 4 Force. If you occupy a battleground site and a battleground system, once during each of your control phases may {{Errata hl|1=reveal}} the bottom card of your Lost Pile and place it on top of your Force Pile. At the end of opponent's turn, opponent must lose 2 Force or place their Force Pile onto their Used Pile.
